content: Language similarities have more impact on transferring syntax than semantics. Without tuning the English encoder, French enjoys 50.3 LAS for being closely related to English, whereas Arabic and Hindi, SOV languages, modestly reach 4.2 and 6.4 points using the SVO encoder. Although Chinese has SVO order, it is often seen as head-final while English is strong head-initial. Perhaps, this explains the poor performance for Chinese.
